blocks.text: The page first finishes the Tara Singh encounter by showing the Singhs regrouping under pressure, with sabhai singh ral bai bhag and layô nagârô turat mardhâi giving the sense of hurried collective response.
It then marks a clean turn into the next chapter with 85. môman khan dî chardhâî, making this page an explicit hinge between one martyrdom sequence and the next official campaign.
Once that heading appears, ab phir bat turkan val âî signals that state initiative has resumed and that the focus is shifting from local clash to a new expedition under Muslim command.
